serverInfo.name: mfr-mcp
serverInfo.title: Mobile Field Report MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Mobile Field Report, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which service requests are still open for the Hamburg team this week?"; "List the appointments planned for next Monday with their technicians."; "Show the open invoices over 30 days old with their customers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mobile Field Report data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mfr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mfr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mfr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mfr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mfr_list_service_requests
tools.title: List service requests
tools.description: List service requests (jobs) with their state, customer, dates and location. Filter with OData $filter, e.g. State eq 'Released'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter, e.g. "State eq 'Released' and DateModified gt datetime'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'".

select.description: OData $select, e.g. 'Id,Name,State'. Not for Items, Steps or Comments.

skip.description: Rows to skip. Follow odata.nextLink for more rows.

tools.name: mfr_get_service_request
tools.title: Get a service request
tools.description: Get one service request by id. Use expand 'Customer,Destination,Appointments,Items/ItemType,Steps,Tags' to load related data. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests(id).

tools.name: mfr_count_service_requests
tools.title: Count service requests
tools.description: Count service requests that match an OData $filter, e.g. State eq 'Released'. Returns a plain number. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests/$count.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter, e.g. "State eq 'Released' and DateModified gt datetime'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'".

tools.name: mfr_list_comments
tools.title: List comments of a service request
tools.description: List the comments of one service request, oldest first, with the author. Internal comments are included, so keep them private. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Comments?$filter=ServiceRequestId eq id.

service_request_id.description: Service request id whose comments to list.

skip.description: Rows to skip. Follow odata.nextLink for more rows.

tools.name: mfr_create_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a service request
tools.description: Add a comment to one service request. Set is_internal true to keep it visible to staff only. Creates a new comment each time, so do not retry blindly. Needs the API Edit permission. Mobile Field Report OData: POST /Comments.

is_internal.description: true = internal comment, not shown to the customer.
